title: SS27 Women's Design and Production Innovations
summary: Body scanning and 3D development, product data ready for the EU's Digital Product Passport, and production planned around new EU rules on unsold stock and low-value imports.

sections.heading: Design: scanning and 3D
sections.body: Balenciaga used 3D body scans to build new mannequins for its July 2026 couture collection<sup>[1]</sup>. The same approach is available to ready-to-wear: scanning fit models and developing first samples in 3D reduces sampling rounds. Forecut's Garment Studio supports drafting and 3D checks before a physical sample.

sections.heading: Product data and regulation
sections.body:
- **Digital Product Passport:** it will not apply to all fashion from the start of 2027; the European Commission plans to adopt the textiles delegated act in the fourth quarter of 2027<sup>[2]</sup>. Brands that collect fibre, origin and care data now will be ready.
- **Unsold goods:** since 19 July 2026, large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel, accessories and footwear in the EU<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Low-value imports:** since 1 July 2026, the EU applies a temporary €3 customs duty per item on consignments worth up to €150<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Ultra-fast fashion:** a French law adopted on 8 July 2026 allows penalties of up to 50% of a product's price<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Production planning
sections.body:
- **Sourcing:** brands are diversifying towards Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, Turkey and Morocco while keeping China relationships<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Calendar:** Lunar New Year falls on 6 February 2027; Vietnamese and Chinese factories slow from late January and usually return to full capacity in early March<sup>[3]</sup>. Plan bulk for later spring drops after the holiday.
- **Climate risk:** the World Meteorological Organization warns that El Niño could bring drought, flooding and extreme heat to key sourcing regions through early 2027<sup>[2]</sup>.

design_implications:
- Develop first samples in 3D and keep physical sampling for final fit and fabric approval.
- Record fibre composition, origin and care for every style from the start.
commercial_implications:
- Buy shallower in the EU and plan rework, resale or donation routes for unsold stock.
- Build buffer time around Lunar New Year and climate disruption into the SS27 critical path.
